text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Arima Kinen. After their heated battle last year, all eyes are on Hishi Amazon and Narita Brian for their big rematch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon is all fired up for her fated one-on-one. Sparks fly as they rev up for the race, and now, the decisive battle is about to begin!
